title: Design System: Dapper Detailing Pros (public website)

display.purpose: Split-hero page titles in two tones, before-grey then after-white. Capped at 96px.

headline.purpose: Section headings, before-grey with the after span in white.

title.purpose: Process steps, timeline entries, packages, rack panel names.

numeral.purpose: Process marks in tape colour, tabular.

lede.purpose: One sentence beside a section headline, muted ink, max 52ch.

textures.name: tape-fibre
textures.purpose: Authored crepe-paper fibre (feTurbulence), multiplied over tape at 50% and over red tape at 25%.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All CSS transitions (hover, underline draw, header hide, rack line).

motion.name: lay
motion.value: back.out(1.6), 1.1s, scaleX/scaleY from the roll end
motion.purpose: Tape being laid with a slight press-down overshoot ([data-lay]).

motion.name: peel
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to 0, 1.4s expo.inOut; image scale 1.18 to 1, 1.8s
motion.purpose: Photos uncovered as a strip is peeled off ([data-peel]).

motion.name: rise
motion.value: y 28 to 0, opacity 0 to 1, 1s, stagger 0.07, expo.out
motion.purpose: Everything else settles in reading order ([data-rise]).

motion.name: scrub
motion.purpose: Process and timeline tapes grow with the scroll.

motion.name: page-sweep
motion.value: 34vh tape strip, scaleX 1 to 0 from the right, 0.9s expo.inOut
motion.purpose: Page change; skipped on first load.

motion.name: hero-lay
motion.value: divider scaleY 0 to 1 (1s expo.inOut), then --x 88% to 50% (1.6s power4.inOut)
motion.purpose: Split hero entrance so the change is seen happening.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transitions disabled; final states shown

narrative.overview:
The site is a detailer's test panel. A strip of masking tape divides each view into before and after, so the page shows the work instead of claiming it. Everything sits on gloss-black paint; masking tape is the only material laid on top of it, and it carries every label, the navigation, the instant-quote tally and the ways forward at the foot of each page. Dapper red is the paint that matters: booking, and the After mark.

Density is low and the type is loud. Big condensed caps run in two tones, the before half in grey and the after half in white, and the body copy is quiet Manrope at a comfortable reading measure. Depth is physical, not interface depth: tape lifts slightly off the paint and casts a soft shadow; nothing floats as a card.

The before side is always an illustration made from the same photograph (hazed, desaturated, washed in tape-brown) and is labelled as such. It is never presented as a real result.
keyCharacteristics: Gloss-black paint ground with three tonal steps; no other surfaces.
Masking tape (crepe-paper fibre texture, slight rotation, soft lift shadow) as the single applied material.
Two-tone condensed caps headlines: before-grey, then after-white.
Dapper red reserved for booking and the After mark.
Square corners everywhere; the only circle is the drag grip.
Motion is tape: laid from the roll end, peeled away, swept across between pages, dragged by the visitor.

rules.name: The Paid-In-Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks only booking and the After side (plus the native control accent). If an element is red, the visitor is either booking or looking at the finished result.

rules.name: The Tape-Carries-Words Rule
rules.body: Labels, navigation and calls to move forward are written on tape in tape ink. Floating coloured text labels are not part of this world.

rules.name: The 96 Ceiling Rule
rules.body: No display text exceeds 96px. Scale comes from condensed width and two-tone contrast, not from size.

rules.name: The Before-Then-After Rule
rules.body: A two-line headline reads grey first and white second. The after half is the point; it gets the light.

rules.name: The Only-Tape-Lifts Rule
rules.body: If it casts a shadow, it is tape. Paint, photos and text stay flat.

dos: Do write labels, navigation and forward actions on tape in tape ink.
Do set section headlines in two tones, before-grey then after-white, capped at 96px.
Do label every before treatment as an illustration ("Before · illustration") and keep real portfolio photographs untreated.
Do credit a photo as a studio photo when it does not show the page's vehicle type; use a tape-labelled panel when a vehicle type has no photo.
Do separate lists with 1px rules instead of boxing them.
Do keep reduced-motion and no-JavaScript states complete: final positions, no movement.
donts: Don't use Dapper red for anything other than booking, the After mark and the native control accent.
Don't round corners; the drag grip is the only circle.
Don't add shadows to paint, photos or text; only tape lifts.
Don't carry the home story's pills, blurred glass panels, micro captions or story reds into the rest of the site.
Don't present a before treatment as a real result or invent prices, results or claims on tape.
